attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: whatsapp_audio_message_ingestion
steps:
  - id: authenticate_system
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "system_integration"
    output: auth_result

  - id: extract_webhook_fields
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: webhook_payload
      field: "message"
    output: raw_message_fields

  - id: validate_webhook_payload
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_message_fields
      schema: whatsapp_audio_message_schema
    output: validated_message_fields

  - id: extract_audio_url
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_message_fields
      field: "audio_url"
    output: audio_url

  - id: fetch_audio_binary
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "{{audio_url}}"
      method: GET
    output: raw_audio_binary

  - id: validate_audio_binary
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_audio_binary
      schema: audio_binary_schema
    output: validated_audio_binary

  - id: send_to_transcription_api
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: validated_audio_binary
      url: "/api/transcription/speech-to-text"
      method: POST
    output: raw_transcription_result

  - id: validate_transcription
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_transcription_result
      schema: transcription_result_schema
    output: validated_transcription

  - id: extract_transcribed_text
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_transcription
      field: "transcribed_text"
    output: transcribed_text

  - id: mask_sensitive_data
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: transcribed_text
      mapping:
        action: "mask_pii"
        fields:
          - "ssn"
          - "phone_number"
          - "credit_card"
          - "national_id"
    output: sanitised_text

  - id: call_ai_classification
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: sanitised_text
      url: "/api/ai/classify-message"
      method: POST
    output: raw_classification_result

  - id: validate_classification
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_classification_result
      schema: classification_result_schema
    output: validated_classification

  - id: extract_classification_flag
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_classification
      field: "es_laboral"
    output: es_laboral_flag

  - id: check_work_request
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "es_laboral_flag == true"
    output: is_work_request

  - id: route_on_classification
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "is_work_request == false"
      target: terminate_non_work
    output: route_result

  - id: extract_recipient_number
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_message_fields
      field: "recipient_number"
    output: recipient_number

  - id: lookup_producer
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: producers
      query:
        assigned_number: "{{recipient_number}}"
    output: raw_producer_record

  - id: validate_producer
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_producer_record
      schema: producer_record_schema
    output: validated_producer

  - id: extract_sender_info
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_message_fields
      field: "sender_info"
    output: sender_info

  - id: prepare_client_record
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: sender_info
      mapping:
        action: "map_to_client_schema"
        producer_id: "{{validated_producer.id}}"
    output: client_payload

  - id: write_client_record
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: client_payload
      table: clients
      upsert: true
    output: client_record

  - id: prepare_ticket
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_classification
      mapping:
        client_id: "{{client_record.id}}"
        producer_id: "{{validated_producer.id}}"
        classification: "{{validated_classification}}"
        status: "open"
    output: ticket_payload

  - id: write_ticket
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: ticket_payload
      table: tickets
    output: ticket_record

  - id: prepare_message_log
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: sanitised_text
      mapping:
        ticket_id: "{{ticket_record.id}}"
        message_text: "{{sanitised_text}}"
        source: "whatsapp_audio"
    output: message_log_payload

  - id: write_message_log
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: message_log_payload
      table: ticket_messages
    output: message_log_result

  - id: log_completion
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: ticket_record
      event: "whatsapp_audio_ingestion_complete"
      details:
        ticket_id: "{{ticket_record.id}}"
        client_id: "{{client_record.id}}"
    output: audit_log_result

  - id: terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "completed"
      message: "Audio message ingested and ticket created successfully"

  - id: terminate_non_work
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "skipped"
      message: "Message classified as non-work request; no ticket created"
